title: The qa block of a repository profile
description: The shape of the OPTIONAL 'qa' key inside a repository's tracked .saga-profile.json. It is an optional key rather than a separate file, following the precedent of branch_preview_command: an optional key leaves every existing profile valid and does not move the repository_profile.v1 token. A repository with no qa key produces a blocked run naming the file and the missing key, never an empty selection that reports a pass.

environment.description: Where a non-production run points. Absent means the run reads the environment identity from the run record instead.

ceiling.description: The per-run budget. A selection whose estimate exceeds either number refuses WHOLE: it never runs the affordable subset and reports a partial pass. A profile with no ceiling is refused, because an absent ceiling is not an unlimited one.

strategies.description: One entry per strategy this repository declares, keyed by the catalogue's strategy identifier. At least one entry must be required: a profile whose strategies are all optional would let a run report a pass having proved nothing.

required.description: A required strategy that is blocked stops the run for the operator. An optional one that is blocked is proof debt.

file_patterns.description: Overrides the catalogue row's patterns for this repository. Absent means the catalogue's patterns apply.

environment_variables.description: Names only. A driver whose named variable is unset returns blocked with the variable named, never passed.

secret_handles.description: Names of operator-held credentials this strategy needs. A missing one refuses the WHOLE selection at preflight, because a credential is the operator's boundary.

commands.description: The declared invocations, for the strategies whose driver runs commands.

scenarios.description: The scenario identifiers the plan may name. A scenario the plan names that is absent here blocks and asks the planner; the functional test never writes its own scenarios.

mandatory_scenarios.description: Scenarios that sit outside any ranking or budget subsetting.

entrypoint.description: For a delegated strategy: the executor this repository hands the strategy to, such as the campps-e2e-canary entrypoint.

targets.description: The declared, installed target variants, for a strategy that has them.

permitted_changes.description: Contract drift this repository accepts without failing.

plugins.description: For installed-surface: which plugins must resolve in every installed root.

expected_surfaces.description: For installed-surface: paths that must exist under each resolved plugin root. A flat list applies to every declared plugin; a mapping keyed by plugin name applies per plugin, which is what a profile naming more than one plugin needs — a command belongs to exactly one of them, and demanding it of all of them reports a failure that is the profile's rather than the fleet's.

cost_estimate.description: Overrides the catalogue row's estimate for this repository.
